## Testing Mode
GREEN

## What
Implement the _adf_to_text helper in bridge/_inbound_utils.py and replace the isinstance(_raw_desc, str) check at _inbound_api.py lines 237-240 with the new helper call. Makes T1 unit tests and T2 integration test go GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add to bridge/_inbound_utils.py:
  def _adf_to_text(value: str | dict | None) -> str:
    - If value is None: return ''
    - If value is a str: return value (back-compat)
    - If value is a dict (ADF): recursively walk doc->content; for each node of type paragraph/heading/listItem, extract text from child nodes of type 'text'; join paragraph texts with '\n'; skip unsupported node types silently (panels, mediaSingle, mentions, inlineCard, mediaGroup)
    - Signature: _adf_to_text(value: str | dict | None) -> str
- Update bridge/_inbound_api.py:
  - Add import: from bridge._inbound_utils import _adf_to_text (alongside existing parse_jira_timestamp import)
  - Replace lines 237-240:
    OLD: _raw_desc = normalized_fields.get('description', ''); jira_description = (_raw_desc if isinstance(_raw_desc, str) and _raw_desc.strip() else None)
    NEW: _raw_desc = normalized_fields.get('description'); jira_description = _adf_to_text(_raw_desc) or None
  - This preserves None semantics when input is None/empty — _adf_to_text returns '' which  converts to None; non-empty text returns the string
- All 5 unit tests (7382-9c1d-4d27-4c8b) must pass GREEN after this change
- Integration test (5f49-c7d6-6807-4ccd) must pass GREEN after this change
- Existing tests in test_bridge_inbound.py, test_bridge_inbound_field_coverage.py, test_bridge_inbound_integration.py must continue to pass

- plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_inbound_api.py (lines 21-22 import update, lines 237-240 call-site fix)
